# WebABC

> WebABC (https://webabc.ir) is a premier web design, full-stack custom development, performance SEO, and AI engine optimization (AEO/GEO) agency serving clients across the Middle East (Dubai, Tehran, Muscat, Riyadh, Abu Dhabi, Qazvin) and internationally. Built on Astro for ultra-fast performance, zero-JS baseline rendering, and optimal AI crawling readability. The site is published in English (`/en`), Persian (`/fa`), and Arabic (`/ar`).

## Company & Overview

- [Home](/en/): Overview of WebABC's services, agency workflow, technology stack, and client case studies.
- [About Us](/en/about/): Agency background, engineering standards, and team profile.
- [Contact & Consultation](/en/contact/): Inquiry form and direct consultation request.
- [FAQ](/en/faq/): Answer Engine Optimized (AEO) FAQs regarding project timelines, pricing, and tech stacks.
- [Privacy Policy](/en/privacy/): GDPR-compliant privacy and data handling practices.
- [Security Policy](https://webabc.ir/.well-known/security.txt): Vulnerability reporting policy and security contacts.

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](/en/services/): Directory of specialized web design, engineering, and organic growth services.
- [SEO & Growth](/en/services/seo/): Enterprise technical SEO, on-page optimization, entity search, and Schema markup.
- [Local SEO](/en/services/local-seo/): Localized search optimization, Google Business Profile management, and regional citations.
- [Web Development](/en/services/web-development/): Custom full-stack Web Application development (Astro, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Cloudflare Edge).
- [WordPress Development](/en/services/wordpress-development/): Custom WordPress themes, WooCommerce storefronts, and headless CMS architecture.
- [Web Design (UI/UX)](/en/services/web-design/): High-conversion UX design, design systems, visual branding, and mobile responsiveness.
- [E-commerce Development](/en/services/ecommerce/): High-speed e-commerce stores, custom checkout flows, and payment integrations.
- [Content Strategy & Creation](/en/services/content-creation/): Semantic SEO content writing, multilingual strategy, and authority blogging.
- [Link Building & Outreach](/en/services/link-building/): High-authority backlink acquisition and digital PR campaigns.
- [Speed & Performance Optimization](/en/services/speed-optimization/): Core Web Vitals optimization, TTFB reduction, edge caching, and asset minification.
- [UI/UX Diagnostic Audit](/en/services/ui-ux-audit/): Comprehensive UX usability, conversion rate, and accessibility audits.
- [Website Maintenance & Security](/en/services/website-maintenance/): 24/7 uptime monitoring, security hardening, automated backups, and software updates.

## Interactive Tools (Free Developer & SEO Utilities)

- [All Developer & SEO Tools](/en/tools/): Interactive client-side web utilities for developers, marketers, and content creators.
- [SEO Headline Analyzer & Title Checker](/en/tools/headline-analyzer/): Score headlines for emotional impact, power words, character length, and Google CTR.
- [SEO Title & Meta Tag Checker](/en/tools/headline-analyzer/): Pixel dimensions, character limits, and keyword positioning analyzer.
- [Website Cost Calculator & Price Estimator](/en/tools/cost-calculator/): Instant interactive budget estimation for web design and development projects.
- [Google SERP Snippet Simulator](/en/tools/serp-preview/): Desktop and mobile search result preview simulator with rich snippets.
- [Content Readability Checker](/en/tools/readability-checker/): Flesch-Kincaid grade level and reading ease analyzer.

- [URL Slug Generator](/en/tools/slug-generator/): Clean, special-character-free SEO URL slug formatter.
- [UTM Link Builder](/en/tools/utm-builder/): Campaign URL generator with analytics parameter tracking.
- [Social Media Card Preview](/en/tools/social-media-preview/): Open Graph and Twitter Card validator.
- [Privacy Policy Generator](/en/tools/privacy-policy-generator/): Instant custom GDPR/CCPA privacy policy document maker.
- [CSS Glassmorphism Generator](/en/tools/glassmorphism-generator/): Interactive CSS backdrop-filter and UI code generator.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](/en/tools/json-formatter/): Secure, client-side JSON formatting and syntax validation.
- [Robots.txt Generator](/en/tools/robots-generator/): Custom crawler directive rules generator.
- [People Also Ask (PAA) Explorer](/en/tools/paa-scraper/): Question research tool for AEO and featured snippet targeting.
- [Schema Markup Generator](/en/tools/schema-generator/): Structured data JSON-LD generator for Organization, Service, and FAQ schemas.
- [FAQ Schema Generator](/en/tools/faq-generator/): Create Schema.org FAQPage structured data markup.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](/en/tools/base64-encoder/): Client-side string and asset Base64 converter.
- [Box Shadow Generator](/en/tools/box-shadow-generator/): Custom CSS shadow code design tool.
- [Color Contrast Checker](/en/tools/color-contrast-checker/): WCAG compliance accessibility color contrast tester.
- [CSS Gradient Generator](/en/tools/css-gradient-generator/): Linear and radial CSS gradient design tool.

- [Meta Tag Generator](/en/tools/meta-generator/): Complete HTML head meta tags builder.
